what: A test suite wrote real fixture rows into a live audit log. Running the test suite left fixture organization names and fixture reasons sitting in the genuine, on-disk audit log a real release would read.
rule: Tests never write under the real install location.
fix: Enforcement: the audit log's own path is now overridable by an environment variable that every test sets to a temporary directory, with a test asserting the real log stays untouched after the suite runs. Regression coverage is in `tests/ship-125.test.mjs`.
